title: Pack a Lunch Box
learning_objectives: Build a balanced meal from options
Practice choosing a variety of foods

events.description: Time to pack your lunch! A great lunch has something from each food group: grains, protein, fruit, veggies, and dairy. Let's start with your main item!

choices.label: Turkey wrap (grain + protein)
choices.effect: A turkey wrap covers grains AND protein! Two food groups in one! Smart pick!

choices.label: PB&J sandwich (grain + protein)
choices.effect: PB&J is a classic! Bread for grains and peanut butter for protein!

choices.label: Pasta salad with cheese (grain + dairy)
choices.effect: Pasta salad with cheese! Grains and dairy covered!

events.description: Great main dish! Now let's add a fruit or veggie. What sounds good?

choices.label: Apple slices
choices.effect: Crisp apple slices! Fruit group covered!

choices.label: Baby carrots
choices.effect: Crunchy carrots! Veggie group covered!

choices.label: Grapes and bell pepper strips
choices.effect: Fruit AND veggies! You're covering lots of food groups!

events.description: Looking good! Let's add one more thing and a drink to finish your lunch.

choices.label: Yogurt + water bottle
choices.effect: Yogurt for dairy and water to stay hydrated! Complete lunch!

choices.label: String cheese + juice box
choices.effect: String cheese for dairy and juice for a sweet drink! All packed!

choices.label: Granola bar + milk
choices.effect: Extra energy from granola and calcium from milk! Well-rounded!

recap_template: You packed an awesome lunch! You included items from different food groups to give you energy all afternoon. Great meal planning!
positive_framing_rules: Never label any food as unhealthy or bad
Use 'gives you energy' and 'helps you grow' language
Celebrate variety and balance, not restriction
ai_variation_allowed: Add fun descriptions of how foods taste
Mention how different foods help your body

title: Balanced Plate Builder
learning_objectives: Build meals that cover all food groups

events.description: Welcome to the school cafeteria! Your plate has 5 sections to fill: grains, protein, vegetables, fruits, and dairy. Let's start with protein — what sounds good?

choices.label: Grilled chicken
choices.effect: Grilled chicken is packed with protein! It helps your muscles grow strong!

choices.label: Black beans
choices.effect: Beans are a great protein source! They also have fiber for energy!

choices.label: Fish sticks
choices.effect: Fish is great for your brain! Protein section filled!

events.description: Protein is on the plate! Now let's fill the grains and veggies sections.

choices.label: Brown rice + broccoli
choices.effect: Rice for grains and broccoli for veggies! Two sections filled at once!

choices.label: Whole wheat roll + corn
choices.effect: A roll for grains and sweet corn for veggies! Great combo!

choices.label: Pasta + side salad
choices.effect: Pasta for grains and salad for veggies! Your plate is filling up!

events.description: Almost there! You need fruit and dairy to complete your plate. What do you pick?

choices.label: Orange + milk
choices.effect: Vitamin C from the orange and calcium from milk! Plate complete!

choices.label: Berries + yogurt
choices.effect: Antioxidants from berries and protein from yogurt! What a plate!

choices.label: Banana + cheese slice
choices.effect: Potassium from banana and calcium from cheese! All 5 sections filled!

recap_template: You built a balanced plate with all 5 food groups! Your body gets different nutrients from each group, and together they give you energy for the whole day.
positive_framing_rules: Focus on what foods give your body, not calories
Celebrate completing the plate regardless of specific choices
ai_variation_allowed: Vary the specific food options per group

title: Snack Shop
learning_objectives: Choose snacks that include fruits or protein
Practice combining money and nutrition thinking

events.description: The school snack shop is open! You have $5. An apple is $1, trail mix is $2, a juice box is $1, and a cookie is $1. You can pick up to 3 items. What do you grab first?

choices.label: Trail mix ($2)
choices.effect: Trail mix has nuts and dried fruit — energy that lasts! $3 left.

choices.label: Apple ($1)
choices.effect: A crunchy apple! Quick energy from natural sugars! $4 left.

choices.label: Cookie ($1)
choices.effect: A tasty cookie treat! $4 left.

events.description: Good pick! What else do you want from the snack shop?

choices.label: Juice box ($1)
choices.effect: Apple juice to drink! Refreshing!

choices.label: Cheese stick ($2)
choices.effect: Cheese stick for protein! Keeps you full longer!

choices.label: Banana ($1)
choices.effect: A banana for quick energy! Great choice!

events.description: Last chance! You have some money left. Do you want one more item or save the rest?

choices.label: One more snack
choices.effect: Your snack bag is full! You picked a great variety!

choices.label: Save the rest for tomorrow
choices.effect: Smart thinking! You'll have money for snacks tomorrow too!

recap_template: You shopped at the snack shop and practiced choosing snacks within a budget! You thought about both what you wanted and what gives you energy.
positive_framing_rules: Never label snacks as junk food or bad choices
Frame all foods as having something to offer
ai_variation_allowed: Add a special deal or sale item
